caption: Created by Me, Private, Shared with Me, All Folders — the folder a report sits in, not a setting on the report, controls who can see it.
Share With picks the audience type, Names searches for the specific role, group, or user, and Access sets what they can do.
The same dialog, scrolled down: every current share, with its access level editable or revocable right there.

steps.label: Viewer
steps.sub: can run reports, can't edit or move them

steps.label: Editor
steps.sub: can build and modify reports and dashboards

steps.label: Manager
steps.sub: full control, including re-sharing the folder

steps.label: Subfolders inherit
steps.sub: a shared folder's children are shared by default

steps.label: Private or hidden
steps.sub: for anything not ready for an audience yet

subtitle: Getting reports to people automatically, on a schedule.
